notes.title: About the problem that the latest version can't play the new level
notes.notes:
After updating the game version, some players said they couldn't play the last two levels.
If you have updated the new version of the game program, but installed the old version of the patch, and then enter the 11th level of the game, and the white screen occurs, then when you install the latest patch, the 11th level may not be able to enter.
Solution: Install the latest patch, and then repeat through the tenth level of the game three times, until the animation dialogue, you can solve the next level can not play the problem.
